htm-preact-standalone.mjs = htm 3.1.1 `preact/standalone.module.js` (unpkg.com/htm@3.1.1),
which bundles htm (Apache-2.0, LICENSE-htm.txt) and Preact 10 (MIT, LICENSE-preact.txt).
Vendored unmodified; served from the daemon binary (DESIGN_SPEC §14.2).

Loaded as a classic script that defines window.uPlot. Vendored unmodified.
